The HP ProBook 450 G10 is a business-grade laptop engineered for robust performance and secure operation within corporate environments.     Incorporates a Fingerprint Reader for secure biometric authentication and a Nano Security Lock Slot for physical asset protection.

  • Integrated Communication Tools
    Features a 720p HD camera, dual stereo speakers, and dual array microphones for clear video conferencing and audio capture.

  • User-Centric Design
    Includes a backlit keyboard for improved visibility in low-light conditions and a Pike Silver chassis for professional aesthetics.

    Comes pre-installed with FreeDOS, allowing for flexible operating system deployment tailored to specific business requirements.
